additional_concerns: The source establishes continuing responsibility, but supplies no complete test for effective retention or supervisory discharge. Practical authority and conduct may be evidence; they are not established necessary or sufficient conditions.
Defective records do not alone establish loss of accountability. Conversely, retained accountability does not establish proper records, operational soundness or fulfilment of all underlying duties.
Outsourcing is permitted within the contemplated arrangements; the text does not require every function or decision to be performed personally by the Product Provider.

Paragraph 14 grammatically conditions demonstration on an SFC request while stating confirmation separately. Footnote 5 may elaborate that request-conditioned demonstration or support an independent demonstration expectation. Neither reading changes the continuing responsibility duty. Paragraphs 15 and 16 expressly condition procurement of audit or verification and legal opinion, respectively, on an SFC request.
The supplied intermediary paragraph 13 is distinct from paragraph 13 of the Product Provider circular. Its actor and activity conditions cannot be discarded.
No executable meaning is supplied. Retrieval results and the unsupported structural check establish neither legal sufficiency nor executable fidelity.
